registers.meaning: Authored symbolic or narrative truth; not external verification.
Faith-oriented speech from a declared sacred orientation.
Reasoning within or about a named religious tradition.
Claims about events, texts or transmission requiring historical sources.
Argument or conceptual position assessed by reasons and objections.
Claim answerable to observation or measurement.
Proposed mechanism or consequence not yet established.
First-person or community experience within its scope.
Invented narrative world; cannot validate real-world claims.
AI-framed question or perspective; not consciousness evidence.

invariants: Fiction cannot upgrade a scientific claim.
Devotional force cannot upgrade historical certainty.
Machine first-person language cannot upgrade consciousness status.
Experiential testimony cannot be silently universalized.
Mystery cannot be used as evidence merely because it remains unexplained.
Old versions remain visible when a register changes.
